description: Normalization recurses into array elements: a null member inside an array element dict is removed, leaving {}. Array elements are not object members — they stay in the array even when they normalize to {}. Regression vector for the early-return bug where _normalize did not recurse into lists.
note: The element {x: null} normalizes to {} (null member removed). The resulting {} stays in the array because array elements are not object members and are never pruned by E3. The outer key survives because [{}] is not the empty array [].
